title: Kinetic starter portal hero + compact step micrographics
creator: Ava Chen
description: Refresh the Quickstart landing hero with a kinetic (lightly animated) starter portal illustration, and design a compact, modular step micrographics system for the three-step onboarding flow. The goal is to provide a single set of exportable assets usable across marketing, docs, and the product quickstart CTA, while keeping runtime cost and page weight low. Deliverables: hero artwork (SVG variants + Lottie fallback), motion spec (timing, reduced-motion behavior), 3 modular step micrographics with annotated responsive rules, a screenshot/crop spec for consistent docs and release notes imagery, and a production handoff package for engineering (SVGs, CSS tokens, export pipeline).
acceptance_criteria: Hero illustration exported as optimized SVG with one lightweight CSS animation variant
Motion spec includes timings, triggers, and reduced-motion alternatives
Three step micrographics available as responsive SVG components and PNG fallbacks
Screenshot/crop spec documented (desktop & mobile) and integrated into docs image pipeline
Design review approved by PM and engineering and assets uploaded to shared Drive + Figma handoff file
Assets labeled and versioned for release console-2026.03

review_feedback: Marcus Rivera (PM) - 2026-02-26: Keep motion subtle; prioritize clarity for first-time users. Suggest micro-bounce on call-to-action and subtle keyline reveal for the portal.

Sofia Martinez (Accessibility) - 2026-03-05: Provide a reduced-motion variant and ensure all decorative motion is skipped when prefers-reduced-motion is set. Contrast pass required for step icon strokes at 14px small sizes.

decisions: Use SVG as primary format with CSS-driven micro-interactions (translate/opacity/scale); no heavy Lottie in product pages
